entities.name: Jelena Dubljević
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jelena Dubljević is a Montenegrin professional basketball player for Botaş SK. She is also part of the Montenegrin national team. She competed in the 2011 Eurobasket tournament with Montenegro. In 2016, Dubljević signed with the Los Angeles Sparks. In her first WNBA season, she won her first WNBA championship with the Sparks after they defeated the Minnesota Lynx 3–2 in the Finals.
